name: selftest-synthetic
title: ND2 Studios self-test (synthetic source)
description: Proves the whole loop against the real engine -- handshake, open, tier-2 validation, set, ingest, run, per-node progress, artifacts, thumbnails, return -- with no data files at all. An empty io.load path yields the deterministic synthetic source, so the result is reproducible and can be pinned by hash. Send an ND2 or TIFF and the same five nodes run on it instead.

knobs.name: channel
knobs.label: Channel
knobs.help: Which channels to keep, as 0-based indices. Left unset every channel goes through.

knobs.name: background_um
knobs.label: Background scale
knobs.help: Top-hat radius in microns. Larger keeps more large-scale structure.

knobs.name: background_polarity
knobs.label: Feature polarity
knobs.help: white = bright objects on a dark background (fluorescence); black = the inverse (brightfield).

knobs.name: method
knobs.label: Segmentation method
knobs.help: Only the two methods that need no model weights are offered here. stardist and cellsam are real choices of this node but pull large downloads, so a recipe that wants them should declare them in requires.capabilities and be reviewed by the operator.

knobs.name: level
knobs.label: Threshold method
knobs.help: How the intensity cut is chosen. 'fixed' is deliberately not offered: it would need the companion threshold number, which this recipe does not expose.

knobs.name: min_area_um2
knobs.label: Minimum object area
knobs.help: Left unset it is derived from the file's own calibration. Pinning it overrides the microscope, so leave it out unless you mean to.

knobs.name: fill_holes
knobs.label: Fill holes
knobs.help: Close interior gaps in each detected region before measuring.

knobs.name: stats
knobs.label: Statistics
knobs.help: Comma-separated intensity statistics to measure per object.
